title: OpenAPI contract, docs page and typed-client decision
objective: OpenAPI generated from the Rust implementation, served as /openapi.json with a development docs page, and a test that keeps documented and actual routes in sync; decide on a generated TypeScript client with evidence.
acceptance_criteria: openapi.json is generated from code, not hand-written
A drift test fails when a route is added without documentation
The typed-client decision is recorded with reasons
